youtube.title: Pyrrhus won the battle and still got cooked 💀 #shorts
youtube.caption:
Pyrrhus of Epirus beat Rome twice… and that's exactly the problem. 🐘💀

His advisor asked "and after that?" one too many times. Then the army count came in.

Would you take that W? 👇

Parody · fictional chat. Based on Plutarch: Cineas asked Pyrrhus why not relax now, and after Heraclea and Asculum (280–279 BC) Pyrrhus said "one more such victory and we are undone" — the origin of the pyrrhic victory.

#pyrrhusofepirus #pyrrhicvictory #romanhistory #ancientrome #historymemes #funnyhistory #shorts
